Initial release of ap-invoice-processing skill.

- Scans an inbox for vendor invoices, extracts key fields, and cites the source for each value.
- Dedupes invoices against the existing AP log by vendor plus invoice number, skipping exact duplicates.
- Appends new invoices to the AP log with status "added by skill, needs review"; any unclear or unreadable field is flagged as "uncertain, needs review".
- Forwards processed emails to the AP system (never approves or pays), labels, and archives them.
- Provides a run summary with counts and details of logged, skipped, and uncertain invoices.
- Operator-configurable detection criteria, vendor exclusion patterns, and scheduled lookback window.
- Strict audit trail and human-in-the-loop design; never acts on guesses or skips legitimate AP invoices based solely on vendor identity.
